title: Chapter 514
paragraphs: Chapter 514
Episode 141. Crash (7)
Sota Desert.
The mission was not carried out only by the knights and the two Black Knights.
'There were... more people?'
Joshua barely raised his head to look at Rosa. Due to the darkness of the underground prison, he couldn't see her expression.
"There were four Black Knights and one Black Swordsmen, and others I had personally hired... I was also in that desert."
"What...!"
Not only Joshua.
None of them, including Jin, Difus, Mon, or Jane, knew that Rosa and her knights were in the Sota Desert.
They were not there from the beginning. They entered the desert after the group started their mission. And their goal was not only to succeed in stealing the blueprint.
"I was watching you."
What choices would the knights make, and how would they succeed in their mission?
Especially, what decisions would Joshua make among them?
Rosa, leading her own troops, hid in the desert and watched the overall flow of the mission.

-Deputy Grand Duke, only Mon remains in the underground construction site. The 2nd grade knights have apparently decided to monopolize the information. However, since Kinzelo also took action at the same time, it will be revealed soon.

-4th grade knights, 12th grade knights, Murakan. We confirmed the start of their movement. We withdrew since there was a high probability of being detected by the security boundary if we continued tracking.

-If it were the youngest, they would already know that the real place is not the construction site but the 2nd tower. Keep an eye on them near the 2nd tower and report back when the youngest group overcomes the barrier.
-Yes, sir!
When the barrier of the 2nd tower was shattered by the sacred sword and the fleet of over a hundred ships appeared, Rosa's side, unlike Jin's group, was not surprised at all.

They had known about it long ago. It was not the first time in the long history of the two families' cold war that the Gifle tried to build a flying fleet centered on Cozak in the Sota Desert. The knights just didn't know.
-How many spies does Gifle have in the Garden of Swords?

-97 servants, 20 junior guardian knights, 12 intermediate guardian knights, 5 senior guardian knights, 15 clerks and stewards of 2nd grade or higher, 2 knight groups, 5 execution knights, 7 elders, and 1 Black Knight. We estimate that there are at least 20 more spies capable of obtaining critical intelligence.
-What about the spies we have planted in Gifle's side?
-At the Gifle residence, 40 servants, 10 junior magicians, 5 intermediate magicians, 1 elder, and 1 tower magician. That's all.
At the last knights' meeting convened by Syron before he left for the Black Sea.
That day, the conversation between Syron and Runtia had a nuance as if Runcandle was far behind Gifle in the intelligence war.
In fact, it was Runcandle, not Gifle, who was extracting more critical internal information. The worst spy, Black Knight Barton Vichena, was killed by Jin and Difus.
It must be Yona, that child who informed Kinzelo about the riders' operation time.
- It probably is. I didn't expect to take on such a double request, Lady Rosa.
Rosa was able to hide in the desert during the Sota Desert mission, avoiding the eyes of Jin's group, Yona, and both Zipel and Kinzelo.
The one person who ruled the Ivory City, the Nameless King Owl.
It was all thanks to hiring him and the best assassins of Nameless.
- I'll take this request.
- You can't.
- I'll go anyway, hehe.
- If you must go, there are a few conditions.
Rosa found Owl right after Yona left.
- When Yona was a reserve rider, I also knew that Lord Owl delayed Yona's family return using Mandokju as an excuse. However, it shouldn't have meant that Yona could betray Lunckandel...
- Betrayal, it's just a request we received. Lady Rosa, you're going too far.
- At least it's just words since Shilon is absent and I came instead.
- Shouldn't Lunckandel be grateful to me for sending Yona to the Sota Desert?
- In a turbulent world, if you sincerely stood by Lunckandel's side, it would be natural to be grateful.
- That's not entirely wrong.

- You must have set a condition for sending Yona. Bring the original or a copy of the blueprint to Sabil. You must have tried to balance between the great powers with that negotiation card. This story isn't entirely wrong either, right?
- Hmm.
- Even if you're a Lord, deceiving Lunckandel has a heavy price. But I don't want to turn Nameless into an enemy because of this. Please go to the Sota Desert with me.
- That would mean my generation of Nameless would be at odds with Zipel, Lady Rosa.
- I won't make it too difficult for you. You don't need to participate in the battle and vault robbery. Just help with hiding. Can't even Yona keep up with you when it comes to hiding others?
Owl did just that, only helping with hiding and observing. Of course, the best assassins of Nameless who came to the Sota Desert with him didn't draw their swords until the incident was over.

- Acting Governor, as of now, the only remaining personnel inside the 2nd tower are Sandra Zipel and 4 members of the Phantom Unit. The 12th and 4th riders have also entered the tower, so the battle should have ended by now.
- We detected a first-class superhuman exerting their power.
- This vibration, it's the realm of swordsmanship. Could they have been here all along...?
- The phenomenon is getting worse. Acting Governor, if this continues, the riders and the Black Knight Jane are likely to die soon. The rescue operation is ready.
- Stand by.
-...Just now, there was a time distortion in the 2nd Tower. The Silver Dragon's Claw must have been used. Yona must have joined the battle as well. Lord Rosa, are you really okay with this?
-You seem worried about Yona, Lord Owl.
-The collapse of the 2nd Tower has begun, and soon Drakka's main forces will arrive. Grandmaster, if you want to approach, now is your last chance.
-Continue to wait.
If it had only been about the mission's success and the survival of the Knights.
Rosa should have entered at that moment.
But Rosa Runecandle wanted to confirm something else.
She was looking forward to the moment when Joshua Runecandle would awaken and enlighten. If not that, she at least wanted to see him make better judgments than his younger sibling.
She believed he could at least do that much.
-First-class superhuman combat has ceased, presumably due to the influence of Sandra Ziepel. The ship Gruenello is moving.
-The 2nd Tower battle is over. The Knights are escaping. Black Knight Jane has suffered fatal injuries, and Sandra Ziepel has joined them.
Even when the Knights met the Zepellin and requested an escort, when Jin demonstrated her wisdom to break through the Lomin Forest, and when Jane sacrificed herself at the central border.
Rosa ultimately did not see the scene she had hoped for.
In the end, it was not Joshua but... Jin who led the mission to success.
"While you were making wrong decisions throughout the mission, trying to save your copies, and losing the family's Black Knight in the process."
"Ah... I was watching all of that."
"Your youngest sibling fought for their life at every moment and eventually succeeded in the mission. Without my help or the family's."
"Why didn't you help? If you had stepped in, couldn't you have saved Knight Jane...!"
"Really? That's what I want to ask you. Why didn't you use the power the prophet embedded in your copy when fighting Hedo?"
Joshua only used that power when Jane sacrificed herself.

"Did you want to save your copies? It wasn't just that. You had expectations. If it was the youngest, if it was Defus, if it was Murakan, if it was the family's Black Knight! Wouldn't you be able to achieve better results without consuming the copies? That disgusting expectation."
"No, I... I eventually set off the volcano."
"That's because by that time, you had no other choice. Weaklings like you are mistaken for having no choice but to make a decision that was forced upon them... "
"I did it... for the family..."

"If you hadn't hesitated to use that power when you faced Hedo, Jane wouldn't have died. I was in the desert. Everyone was prepared to face death more than once, but you saved your copies until the end. That was your true choice and will."
Joshua had nothing to say.
He felt as if he had been pierced through and exposed, even more so than if he had been stripped bare and had all his internal organs revealed.

"And then, scared out of your wits, you led the knights back to the family, stuttering and trembling at my mere probing, begging for forgiveness...? When you were cut by my sword just now, you couldn't even let out a scream or counterattack?"
Beyond right and wrong, it was a testament to sheer will and transcendent struggle.
Until the very end, Joshua only brought disappointment to Rosa.

What was even more bitter for her was the fact that when Joshua had been harboring disgusting expectations for Jin, she herself had been doing the same. From a certain point, Rosa had also focused not on Joshua's choices, but on how far Jin could go.
Jin Runecandle, her youngest son.
He always had the power to make everyone expect great things, just like Luna once did.
"It's not just the Sota Desert, Joshua. I've sent eyes to watch you in numerous missions you've participated in, and I've never been satisfied even once."
"Kill me... I'm not worth living. Neither my mother nor the family members will have anything to expect from me anymore."

"This place is where you can't die even if you want to. Your sins are not light enough to be resolved by death. And as you said, I don't expect anything from you anymore. But, the prophecy you possess."
Sirun Runecandle calls the shadows again and takes...
Joshua Runecandle.
Joshua Runecandle calls the shadows again and takes them. The shadow will never leave the world again in the glory of Joshua Runecandle.
Finally, your war will end in victory, and eternal blessings will descend upon the earth.
Praise the one who called the shadows.
"The divine language that feels so absolute still seems worth expecting."
Joshua burst into laughter unknowingly at that point.

"Puhuhu... Prophecy? Just a moment ago, you praised my outstanding siblings and the value of the family, told me that my place is not on the ground but in the abyss... and now you say you expect that prophecy that hasn't manifested yet?"

"You haven't died yet. And I expect not only the realization of the prophecy but also the struggle to break it. Your youngest sibling, Jin. It doesn't seem like that child's struggle won't be able to break the prophecy, no matter how absolute it is."
"Ha."
"Prophecy and struggle, which side do you think I have more expectations for?"
Rosa, turning her back.
She spoke these last words with a hint of sarcasm.

"If the day comes when your prophecy leads you from this underground prison to the real world of struggle, and if you endure that world, I will bring you back to the surface. Of course... as always, your prophecy will disappoint me again. Just as you've always done."
